title: Switched from G5 to G6 and now there's no data on Nightscout
body: We just switched my son from his Dexcom G5 to the G6 2 days ago and when we did so Nightscout immediately stopped receiving data.  What do I need to fix and how to get it back up again?  He is 7 years old and his school uses Nightscout to follow him.  Thanks in advance!

comments.body:
Do you have readings on xDrip?
Do you have internet connectivity?
What does xdrip->status  - uploaders status say?
Can you try and reset the nightscout site that you have?
@nhowell2010 Would you please close this issue as you received a response the next day but you never replied?
